pick.why: closest to the default's 3 s misses without more cut-ins (offline, 32 two-party user sessions): +4.6 [0.0, +9.3] misses, -0.13 [-0.53, +0.34] cut-ins vs the default replayed

a2.protocol: eot-bench v2 (AMI dev 974 / ICSI held-out 1312 windows, primary = target), served TS-VAD head runs/tsvad_spk.pt; prints: vp<L> = L s of the primary's single-speaker speech elsewhere in the meeting (tsvad.py bank rule), arm<L> = the first L s of speech after the last other-speaker end before the primary's onset (live, after agent_end), mem5p0 = armed the same way at the primary's previous turn and kept (session memory); the vp5p0 turn rows are A.2's tsvad_spk (same print). Turn rows: the served turn head on each track, cross-fitted <= 5 % per-turn FC, 6 s horizon, 1000 paired bootstraps (scripts/research/tsvad_enroll.py tracks / frame; tsvad.py scores / report)

turn_offline_ami.what: turn-end misses, AMI dev n = 974, 6 s horizon, <= 5 % per-turn false cut-offs (cross-fitted)

turn_offline_icsi.what: turn-end misses, held-out ICSI n = 1312, 6 s, <= 5 % per-turn false cut-offs (cross-fitted)

stages: manifest (2 AMI + 2 ICSI train meetings, 112 crops, 112 turn windows, 12 LibriSpeech speakers, 1.0 h ASR manifest)
train s1 heads only (30 steps, ~0.5 s/step, batch 4)
train s3 --unfreeze 5 --asr-kd (20 steps; gate fired 1x at the smoke LR, restored + LR x0.5, then passed)
